digest.component_or_area: rebar_reconciler apply layer – comment dedup seam crossing
propositions: No end-to-end test existed that crossed the apply-to-differ seam with a real BindingStore to verify the is_comment_mapped guard discriminates recorded from unrecorded comments
Differ tests seeded map state via private _StubBindingStore while apply tests seeded synthetic payloads, creating layered invariants that masked inert guards
New seam-crossing test posts a real envelope through _record_comment_id to a real BindingStore, then re-diffs the same store to assert recorded comments skip and unrecorded controls still emit

Inert-guard variant forces is_comment_mapped to False on the store instance to prove re-emission occurs when the guard is disabled, verifying the assertion depends on the guard rather than passing vacuously
The test uses the real acli_cli_ops.add_comment stubbed only at _run_acli subprocess level and the recorded ACLI_SUCCESS_ENVELOPE fixture to obtain a transport return
Jira-side body diverges from all local bodies so secondary body-equality skip cannot mask an inert primary id-identity skip
